subject.name: Robin
subject.classification: multi-agent system for end-to-end biological scientific discovery

finding.summary: FutureHouse's current research page, published May 19, 2026, describes Robin as a multi-agent system that integrates hypothesis generation, experimental strategy, data analysis, and follow-up insight generation in a continuous biological-discovery workflow. The page also reports experimental follow-up in primary human retinal pigment epithelium stem cells and states that the work was published in Nature.
finding.why_in_scope: The system is explicitly presented as automating a scientific discovery loop beyond literature retrieval, including hypothesis generation, experimental planning, analysis, and follow-up insight generation.
